summary: Issue #2 requests the ability to correct or update an existing Daymark task. The React app currently supports adding, completing, deleting, filtering, searching, and local-storage persistence, but has no edit state or edit controls.
requirements: A user can open an existing task and edit its title, notes, category, priority, and due date.
A user can explicitly save valid edits or cancel without changing the task.
Blank or whitespace-only titles are rejected with accessible validation feedback.
Saved edits preserve task identity and completion state, update views and filters immediately, and persist after reload.
Existing add, complete, delete, search, and filter behavior continues to work.
constraints: Generate acceptance scenarios before application changes.
Stay within the paths and 12-file budget declared by .harness/config.json.
Run lint, test, build, path-safety, and all required Playwright scenarios with no console errors.
assumptions: All Todo fields except id and completion state are editable.
Only one task is edited at a time.
Cancel restores the original task without persisting draft values.

sources.summary: Open issue requests editing an existing task when details need correction or updating.
A separate open implementation confirms expected editing scope but has not been merged into the current base branch.
